coordinate_system.centre_pattern: Centre plus ±5 mm on x and y at each depth; centre offsets are distinct from 5 mm tip spacing

instruments.load_interpretation: ETA input specifications preserved as supplied; no input circuit assembled or R/C effects applied. Scope R/C belongs downstream of the active probe output.
instruments.scaling_definition: probe physical output=unloaded tip difference/physical attenuation; displayed voltage=probe output*selected scope display ratio
instruments.status: User-supplied specifications and ideal gain bookkeeping only; actual settings unconfirmed

waveform_window.Vpp_definition: max(real summed carrier waveform)-min over the finite stated samples; sub-sample extrema are not solved
waveform_window.modulation_definition: 2min(abs(delta_phi_2000),abs(delta_phi_2010)); envelope depth, not a physical 10Hz voltage spectral component
waveform_window.spectrum_definition: Coherent real-waveform DFT, peak phasor 2*FFT/N at2000/2010Hz; remaining-bin maximum retained
